PCRE2 10.49
Source: https://codeload.github.com/PCRE2Project/pcre2/zip/refs/tags/pcre2-10.49
Archive SHA256: cf21acc48d3b77aa2cde80bf186f0db274fef1080ee4617b888f1236cd42d3be
Licence: LICENCE.md

Vendored C sources are unmodified. config.h and pcre2.h are copies of
the upstream generic headers. The default character tables are copied
from pcre2_chartables.c.dist. Built statically in 8-bit UTF/UCP mode,
without JIT or the command-line tools.
